text:
nina: FYI saw consistent p99 spikes when offload crosses NUMA in embedder-concurrent. Many small requests cause remote staging churn.

tom: paste trace?

nina: snippet:
alloc(batch=512K)->remote_staging node1->node2
cross-numa page-in 1.2ms -> 9.1ms
p99 embedder 28ms -> 72ms

reza: placement vs fragmentation. If we reserve too much local for latency lanes small allocs die.

chris: proposal: runtime-level 'lanes' (latency, normal, background). Lanes tune placement+eviction. latency lane gets soft reservations & preemptive KV retention.

sara: telemetry to add: lane_hit_rate, lane_evictions/sec, cross_numa_page_ins, migration_cost_ms.

nina: also propose soft_reservation API: runtime requests N bytes for lane with lease_ms, allocator returns granted bytes (best-effort). No hard pin to avoid OOMs.

tom: API sketch:
context_set_allocation_lane(ctx, LANE_LATENCY);
size_t allocate_reservation(tenant,lane,bytes,lease_ms);

reza: small-run split fast-path: when free run >=64K split into small-chunk slabs instead of relocate. NUMA-aware: prefer local splits.

chris: owner-local background migrator avoids cross-node locks; migrator checks lease & budget before moving. Prefer remap/mmap when supported.

infra-bot: perfbot: embedder-concurrent p99 regression reproduced (ci/emb-204).

sara: add alert: if lane_hit_rate<0.7 && p99>baseline*1.2 -> page SRE. Will add dashboard tiles.

nina: non-blocking requirement: allocations on latency lane must not block inference threads. If reservation shortfall -> fallback to best-effort + async prefetch.

tom: plan: API PR (chris), allocator internals + soft-reserve (reza), small-run split (nina), telemetry (sara), per-tenant caps (jamie). Flag gated canary after staging.

ops-bot: canary scheduled: numa-priority-lanes-v1 -> 2026-03-23T02:00Z (50 hosts).

nina: thanks, keeping thread open for CI reproducer notes.
